newsitem.title: UK: Princess Diana to breakfast with Hillary Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana to breakfast with Hillary Clinton.

text.p: Princess Diana, newly divorced from heir to the throne Prince Charles and stripped of her royal title, will be honoured on Tuesday at a fundraising breakfast with U.S. First Lady Hillary Clinton.

Britain's Press Association news agency said Diana would be Clinton's guest of honour at a fundraising breakfast for breast cancer research. The 120 guests will include Washington socialites and popular fashion designers.
She is scheduled to attend a gala evening on Tuesday night in aid of the Nina Hyde Breast Cancer Fund.
Diana frequently demonstrates her fondness for the United States, where she is still certain to be treated as royalty.
She visited New York late last year and Chicago at the beginning of this summer.
Diana is no longer Her Royal Highness since her divorce but remains Princess of Wales.
She is scheduled to visit Australia and Italy before the end of the year.
